context: Plugin 1.13.0: bundled server now spawns via sh -lc login shell, fixing minimal-PATH teams/GUI sessions for all POSIX users with zero per-repo config. Repo drops its .mcp.json pin + deny + mcp-deny-sync CI job. SessionStart hook detection updated to mirror the login-shell resolution. Windows fallback documented.
rationale: supersedes the 07-09 decision to keep bare npx and only warn via SessionStart hook. What changed since: env-expansion facts were rechecked (no platform conditionals exist, so there is genuinely no both-platforms option), the per-repo workaround demonstrated ongoing field cost (brittle exact-command deny needing a CI job to police), and zero Windows plugin users have materialized. The burden inverts to the hypothetical Windows user: documented one-line project .mcp.json with bare npx, no deny needed since their sh server never spawns.
summary: Switched the plugin's bundled server to the sh -lc login-shell wrapper (Dave approved via explicit trade-off question)
